import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    b = list(map(int, input[1:]))
    
    a = [0] * n
    a[0] = b[0] + 1
    for i in range(1, n):
        if b[i] >= a[i - 1]:
            print("NO")
            return
        a[i] = b[i] + a[i - 1]
    
    print("YES")
    print(" ".join(map(str, a)))

main()
